# Mittal Collections

> Mittal Collections is an online home furnishing store based in Ghaziabad, India, selling bedsheets, curtains, cushions, towels, doormats and related products with pan-India delivery.

Standard delivery across India takes 3-7 business days. Same-day (24-hour) express delivery is available in and around Ghaziabad (Vasundhara, Vaishali, Indirapuram and nearby areas). Cash on Delivery and online payment (Razorpay) are both supported. Products can be returned per the return policy linked below.
